CREATE TABLE fdbk_g1 (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    item_id TEXT,
    ref_id TEXT,
    uid TEXT,
    rtg REAL,
    ttl TEXT,
    body TEXT,
    ts INTEGER,
    hlp_ct INTEGER,
    vrf INTEGER,
    FOREIGN KEY (ref_id) REFERENCES items_g1(ref_id)
)

sql: SELECT MIN(rtg) mn, MAX(rtg) mx, COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN rtg IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nulls FROM fdbk_g1;

SELECT AVG(f.rtg) AS avg_rating, COUNT(*) AS review_count, COUNT(DISTINCT i.ref_id) AS item_count
FROM fdbk_g1 f
JOIN items_g1 i ON i.ref_id = f.ref_id
WHERE i.prc > 50;
SELECT COUNT(*) orphan FROM fdbk_g1 f LEFT JOIN items_g1 i ON i.ref_id=f.ref_id WHERE i.ref_id IS NULL;
SELECT AVG(f.rtg) avg_rating, COUNT(*) rc FROM fdbk_g1 f JOIN items_g1 i ON i.ref_id=f.ref_id WHERE i.prc>50 AND i.main_cat='Office Products';
SELECT AVG(i.avg_rtg) item_avg FROM items_g1 i WHERE i.prc>50;
